Name: Crop Growth Adjustments
Author: gzhynko
Description:
[b]Crop Growth Adjustments[/b] [b](CGA)[/b] allows you to adjust crop growth parameters through content packs. These adjustments are applied to one crop at a time and include the following:
[list]
[*]Change seasons crops grow in[/*]
[*]Change seasons crops produce in[/*]
[*]Make crops hibernate in certain seasons[/*]
[*]Add special sprites for certain seasons (example: grape vine covered in snow during winter).[/*]
[/list]
Adjustments are added in the form of [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Content_packs]content packs[/url]. See [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/stardew-mods/blob/master/CropGrowthAdjustments/docs/author-guide.md]author guide[/url] on GitHub for info on creating content packs for CGA.


[size=4]Installation[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip its folder into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Install any of the existing adjustment packs or create your own and put them into your Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Compatible with SMAPI 4.2 and higher (the latest version is recommended).[/*]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6 and higher.[/*]
[/list]

Crop Growth Adjustments is [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/tree/master/CropGrowthAdjustments]open-source[/url]﻿ and is licensed under the [url=https://github.com/gzhynko/StardewMods/blob/master/LICENSE]0BSD License[/url]﻿.
